{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data_clean = data_dedup[data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data_clean[
    (data_clean['arm'] == 'control') & 
    (data_clean['severity'] == 'moderate')
]

# Compute the fraction who responded
n_total = len(control_moderate)
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print only the required numbers
print(n_total)
print(n_responded)
print(fraction_responded)"}
